# Execution and Verification Pass

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

> From plan into pixel the Awtsmoos renews the road; Awtsmoos.com earns completion only when evidence carries the load.

## Execution order

1. Create the shared runtime directory and small painter modules.
2. Make scene sampling consume canonical keyframes and transforms.
3. Make the renderer visibly represent all 2D/3D/character/particle/chart/text/overlay kinds.
4. Add an offline proof tool that renders the exact 180-second movie at deterministic timestamps/frames.
5. Prefer ffmpeg for fast offline encoding if installed; otherwise use the browser capture path.
6. Inspect the concurrently landed app adapters and run translation checks for Animator, Mitzvah Studio, Nesher, and Video Editor.
7. Run validator and feature-coverage tests against the 18-scene proof.
8. Encode the movie, measure duration with ffprobe, sample frames from multiple scenes, and compare hashes to prove motion/scene variation.
9. Launch the browser showcase, verify desktop and narrow mobile layouts, interact with playback controls, and inspect console errors.
10. Re-read every file written by this pass, check line counts/tabs/syntax, compare planned versus actual, and record remaining work.

## Completion gate

Completion requires a real encoded artifact close to exactly 180 seconds, many distinct non-static frame samples, coverage of every requested feature family, functioning AI-to-document semantics, functioning app translation seams, mobile evidence, and no unresolved critical test failures.
